points.text: The shampoo contains 1% salicylic acid based on the finished product weight.
To use, apply an appropriate amount to wet scalp and hair, lather gently, and rinse thoroughly.

In an in-house test by Seoribitgyeol on 25 adults aged 20 to 55 with visible scalp flakes who used the product once every two days for 14 days without other exfoliating shampoos or scalp scrubs, visible flake reduction was observed after 2 weeks based on internal evaluators comparing baseline photos to photos taken 24 hours after the final use.
All purchases for the Singapore official store include applicable taxes and free shipping.
The 2-bottle bundle consists of two 300 mL bottles totaling 600 mL, not a single 600 mL bottle.
From October 14 to October 31, 2026 Singapore time, orders strictly exceeding S$40.00 after discounts receive one 40 mL travel-size bottle while supplies last, limited to one per order.
The travel-size gift offer strictly excludes any order that includes the 2-bottle bundle, even if single bottles are added to raise the order total.
